title: Agent text is rendered as markdown
body:
`ui::draw_transcript` draws an `Entry::Agent` through `wrapped`, which splits the text on newlines and wraps each paragraph with `textwrap::wrap`. The agent's markdown shows as typed: fences, `#` headings and table pipes are all visible.

## Proposal

- coax depends on the renderer crate split out of foam (foam-000075 in foam's tracker) and draws agent text with its `render(text, width)`.
- A message still streaming is rendered again on each new chunk. A finished message keeps its lines until the width changes.

## Open

- Whether thoughts are rendered as markdown too, or stay dimmed plain text.
- Bold, italics, links and blockquotes come out literal in foam's renderer today. Which of them the renderer learns depends on the coax output style (see that issue).
